name: Greek Mythology Notable Women
title: Greek Mythology Notable Women
description: Mortal and immortal women of note from ancient Greek mythology.

rows.name: Alcestis
rows.description: daughter of Pelias and wife of Admetus, who was known for her devotion to her husband

rows.name: Amymone
rows.description: the one daughter of Danaus who refused to murder her husband, thus escaping her sisters' punishment

rows.name: Andromache
rows.description: wife of Hector

rows.name: Andromeda
rows.description: wife of Perseus, who was placed among the constellations after her death

rows.name: Antigone
rows.description: daughter of Oedipus and Jocasta

rows.name: Arachne
rows.description: a skilled weaver, transformed by Athena into a spider for her blasphemy

rows.name: Ariadne
rows.description: daughter of Minos, king of Crete, who aided Theseus in overcoming the Minotaur and became the wife of Dionysus

rows.name: Atalanta
rows.description: fleet-footed heroine who participated in the Calydonian Boar hunt

rows.name: Briseis
rows.description: a princess of Lyrnessus, taken by Achilles as a war prize

rows.name: Caeneus
rows.description: formerly Caenis, a woman who was transformed into a man and became a mighty warrior

rows.name: Cassandra
rows.description: a princess of Troy cursed to see the future but never to be believed

rows.name: Cassiopeia
rows.description: queen of Æthiopia and mother of Andromeda

rows.name: Clytemnestra
rows.description: sister of Helen and unfaithful wife of Agamemnon

rows.name: Danaë
rows.description: the mother of Perseus by Zeus

rows.name: Deianeira
rows.description: the third wife and unwitting killer of Heracles

rows.name: Electra
rows.description: daughter of Agamemnon and Clytemnestra, she aided her brother Orestes in plotting revenge against their mother for the murder of their father

rows.name: Europa
rows.description: a Phoenician woman, abducted by Zeus

rows.name: Hecuba
rows.description: wife of Priam, king of Troy, and mother of nineteen of his children

rows.name: Helen
rows.description: daughter of Zeus and Leda, whose abduction brought about the Trojan War

rows.name: Hermione
rows.description: daughter of Menelaus and Helen; wife of Neoptolemus, and later Orestes

rows.name: Iphigenia
rows.description: daughter of Agamemnon and Clytemnestra; Agamemnon sacrificed her to Artemis in order to appease the goddess

rows.name: Ismene
rows.description: sister of Antigone

rows.name: Jocasta
rows.description: mother and wife of Oedipus

rows.name: Medea
rows.description: a sorceress and wife of Jason, who killed her own children to punish Jason for his infidelity

rows.name: Medusa
rows.description: a mortal woman transformed into a hideous gorgon by Athena

rows.name: Niobe
rows.description: a daughter of Tantalus who declared herself to be superior to Leto, causing Artemis and Apollo to kill her fourteen children

rows.name: Pandora
rows.description: the first woman

rows.name: Penelope
rows.description: loyal wife of Odysseus

rows.name: Phaedra
rows.description: daughter of Minos and wife of Theseus

rows.name: Polyxena
rows.description: the youngest daughter of Priam, sacrificed to the ghost of Achilles

rows.name: Semele
rows.description: mortal mother of Dionysus

rows.name: Thrace
rows.description: the daughter of Oceanus and Parthenope, and sister of Europa
